risks: Privacy of patients named in incident reports; blame of staff if results identify individuals or wards.
consent: Research use without individual consent depends on the privacy office's decision; if refused, the work proceeds only as internal quality review under existing safety policy, without publication.
data: Extraction into a de-identified dataset on the pharmacy's restricted drive; no staff or ward names; results by episode only.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: children (the paediatric oral solution) and patients with limited English, who may be less able to question an unfamiliar product, are considered; the paediatric episode is reported separately.
partnerships: Medication safety committee, nursing practice leads, paediatric pharmacy team.
rebPath: Hospital research ethics review after the privacy office decision; publication only if research use is approved.
limitations: Under-reporting; one hospital; no external comparison.
summary: Privacy decision pending; no staff blame; paediatric episode reported separately.
